site.name: Chavez Mine
site.location: Boulder County Tungsten Mining District near Nederland
overview: Chavez Mine is a documented tungsten mine in Boulder County's historic tungsten district near Nederland.
U.S. Geological Survey Mineral Resources Data System-derived records identify Chavez as a tungsten-producing mine and preserve a stable mine-level location at roughly 8,550 feet elevation.
moreHistory: The federal mineral record classifies Chavez Mine as a producer and preserves a U.S. Bureau of Mines production-table reference associated with owner-operator Joe A. Chavez. The available record does not provide enough site-specific detail to state production totals or a detailed operating chronology.

The retained mine point at approximately 39.9567, -105.50110 agrees closely with independent mineral-locality indexing for Chavez Mine in the Boulder County Tungsten Mining District. It identifies the historic mine locality without claiming that a surviving opening has been field surveyed or is safe to approach.
